senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. preced.; cmp. מָר, to rebel against. Part. מוֹרֶה.—סורר ומ׳ (בן) the rebellious son, amenable to the law (Deut. XXI, 18–21).
units: Snh. VIII, 1 מאימתי נעשה בן ס׳ ומ׳ when is one to be dealt with as a sorer umoreh? Ib. 68ᵇ; a. fr.—Pl. מוֹרִים, מוֹרִין, v. מוֹרֶה II, a. מוֹרוֹס.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42:8">Gen. R. s. 42</cite>, end (play on <cite ref="M01679"><he>מַמְרֵא</he></cite>) <he>שה׳ פנים וכ׳</he> he showed a stern countenance against Abraham (rebuking him).

senses.gloss: to provoke, to rebel. Y. Kidd. IV, beg. 65ᵇ (play on אמר, Neh. VII, 61) שהִימְרוּ לאל וכ׳ they provoked God with their evil doings.
units: Ex. R. s. 1, end שעתידים להַמְרוֹת וכ׳ that they will rebel at the Red Sea; a. fr.—Esp. to disregard the authority of the Supreme Court (v. מַמְרֵא II).

senses.gloss: to incite one against the other, to arrange a race; to bet.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 25b:6">Snh. 25ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>מפריחי יונים</he>) <he>שמַמְרִין וכ׳</he> those who race doves (and bet on them).
<cite ref="Shabbat 31a:1">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> top <he>שהִמְרוּ זה את זה</he> who entered a wager.
